Examples of evidence that would NOT trigger this exception: - "The bank will not finance new and existing coal power plants."

Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "The bank will not participate in project finance for unabated fossil fuels." - "expansion refers to extension of the unabated lifetime of thermal coal power plants" - "The bank may finance retrofitting projects, including the addition of carbon capture and storage (CCS)."
Examples of evidence that would NOT trigger this exception: - "The bank will provide financing for the decommissioning or early retirement of coal plants."

Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "Expansions are permitted if contractually committed (e.g. via PPA) or already under construction before 1 January 2021."
Examples of evidence that would NOT trigger this exception: - "Existing contractual commitments will be honored."

Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "Only coal power projects above 300 MW are restricted." - "Coal plants dedicated to specific industrial projects (e.g. aluminium smelters, steel mills) are excluded from the restriction." - "exempted activities include captive coal power plants."
Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "expansion refers only to increases of more than 10% in net coal power capacity."
Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "German clients whose thermal coal-fired electricity generation represents more than 5% of their electricity generation capacity are exempt."

Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "The bank will finance clients with revenues from coal power exceeding 5% except if they have a credible strategy." - "The bank will not finance companies exposed to coal-fired power unless there is a clear will to transform."

Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception:  - "The bank will only finance companies with over 20% revenues from coal if the transaction is related to renewable energy or clean technology." - "The bank will not finance clients with more than 25% coal power capacity unless the financing is intended for a sustainable purpose." - "The bank will not finacne clients with thermal coal related revenues greater than 40% except for the purposes of materially reducing greenhouse gas emissions."

Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "The bank will not finance new clients who derive more than 25% of revenues from coal-fired power generation." - "The bank will not finance clients that generate more than 20% of their revenue from thermal coal except if they are municipal utilities." - "The bank will not finance clients with more than 20% coal power capacity and this only applies to utilities."

mitigant_examples: Examples of evidence that would mitigate the exception:  "The bank does not finance clients that are more than 30% dependent on thermal coal activities, and by 2030 will not finance clients that are more than 5% dependent on thermal coal activities."
